@gideon.sato Draft incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (Vantorre, Hartford gate kiosks, Aug 3, 2026). Times are as logged in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Summary: Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, so gate check-in was unavailable. Scheduling continued to work from the dispatch office.

First report: 10:42 AM, when the incident was logged.
Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch confirmed it.
Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

Open items: status-page access for the procurement account was still being investigated. Tracked under INC-4821. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for gateway reconnect diagnostics, and the reconnect log went to Odile Brandt. The incident stays open for another arrival cycle.

Posted the draft in #strategic-random for you to review. It's not sent to Mateo or his team.
